DeliveryCausalParent.title: DeliveryCausalParent
DeliveryCausalParent.description: Causal parent of a delivery event: an earlier event in the same delivery stream (the W010 shape).

DeliveryStreamId.title: DeliveryStreamId
DeliveryStreamId.description: Opaque delivery-event stream identity: "stream:" followed by a lowercase slug (the W010 stream grammar).

DeliveryEventSequence.title: DeliveryEventSequence
DeliveryEventSequence.description: One delivery-event sequence number: 1-based, contiguous per delivery stream.
